page_title: VLL 0-1 ALA | Valladolid v Alaves 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+3' Isidro Diaz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valladolid comes to nothing.

90+2' Adrian Arnuncio (Valladolid) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Adrian Arnuncio (Valladolid) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Valladolid get a corner.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) picks up a caution.
87' Alvaro Rubio decides to make a substitution. Antonio Candela will be replaced by Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid).
86' Substitution. Antonio Blanco makes way for Carlos Protesoni (Alaves).

86' Adam Aznou (Valladolid) produces a stunning solo run from the middle of the pitch, all the way to the penalty area. He unleashes a decent strike which goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.

84' That was close! Adrian Arnuncio (Valladolid) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
83' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Valladolid was in an offside position.
81' Valladolid take a short corner kick.
81' Raul Moro (Valladolid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Valladolid have been awarded a corner kick.

80' Kike Garcia (Alaves) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.

75' What a save from Antonio Sivera! Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
73' Here comes a substitution. Anuar is given a rest as he is replaced by Adrian Arnuncio (Valladolid).
69' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
69' The referee blows his whistle, Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
69' Kike Garcia (Alaves) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Corner kick. Alaves will have an opportunity.
68' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
67' Valladolid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
67' Anuar (Valladolid) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. Good work from Valladolid as they win a corner.
65' Joan Jordan (Alaves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jon Guridi.
65' Eduardo Coudet has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tomas Conechny (Alaves) replacing Carles Alena.
64' The attendance is 14506.

60' Raul Moro (Valladolid) meets a cross inside the box and heads it goalwards. Unfortunately for him, he sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
59' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
56' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
55' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) commits a foul and Isidro Diaz immediately signals a free kick.
53' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
52' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' Alvaro Rubio has made a change at the break. Ivan Sanchez has come on in place of Xavier Moreno (Valladolid).
46' Alvaro Rubio makes a half-time substitution. Florian Grillitsch (Valladolid) comes on in place of Selim Amallah.
46' Alvaro Rubio makes a switch. Ibrahim Alani (Valladolid) is coming on in place of Mario Martin at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Valladolid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.

45+2' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' > collects a rebound after the corner kick and sends in a snap shot at goal, but it flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
44' It will be a corner kick for Alaves.
44' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The linesman points to the corner flag, Alaves are going to take it.

43' Jon Guridi (Alaves) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Alaves will have a corner.
43' Some great controlled play and passing from Alaves. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
41' Xavier Moreno (Valladolid) serves up a nice cross, but Antonio Sivera punches the ball away.

32' So close! Carlos Vicente (Alaves) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
31' Mario Martin (Valladolid) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Alaves.
30' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
30' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. Alaves win a corner.
18' 0 - 1 Goal! Kike Garcia (Alaves) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Karl Hein to commit before slotting the penalty into the right of the goal.
18' A player from Valladolid pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Alaves are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.

16' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Alaves force a corner. They send men into the box.
14' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

12' Great touch by Kike Garcia (Alaves) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save! The ball is out of play. Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner.
8' The free kick is taken by Carles Alena (Alaves), but ball is cleared.
8' Isidro Diaz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Selim Amallah (Valladolid). A free kick has been awarded to Alaves.

5' Jon Guridi (Alaves) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Alaves will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Isidro Diaz.
